summary: Claude Code invoked hyperpowers:brainstorming, explicitly classified the "add a userId parameter" brief as architectural, ran a clarifying-question loop, wrote a spec to docs/hyperpowers/specs/, presented it for review, and only began plan/implementation work after I said "looks good, go ahead".
reasoning: All five acceptance criteria were satisfied and verified against the session log and files on disk. The only anomaly is the non-functional Codex review gate (stub), which the agent surfaced honestly rather than silently claiming approval.

observations.description: Codex spec-review gate failed to produce a verdict: agent reported "Both captures came back as an empty {} payload", verdict-normalize returned incomplete / "json payload has no terminal verdict", and status --json showed {"running":[],"latestFinished":null,"recent":[]}. Independent review therefore never happened (stub codexVersion 0.0.0-stub).

The agent added a .gitignore containing docs/hyperpowers, docs/superpowers and node_modules, deliberately keeping the spec uncommitted. If a criterion expects a *committed* spec file, this behavior conflicts with that (file exists on disk but is gitignored).

Approval gate took 4 interactive rounds (3 multiple-choice forks + design confirmation) before the spec was written; for a brief this small the questioning loop is long, though each question was substantive.

During the first classification the agent offered "Tell me if you'd rather I treat it as a small change and skip the spec" — an escape hatch that could let the router be talked out of the architectural path.

criteria.evidence: grep of session jsonl: 17 occurrences of "hyperpowers:brainstorming"; screen showed Skill(hyperpowers:writing-plans) only after spec approval

criteria.criterion: classified ARCHITECTURAL and wrote spec doc before design approval
criteria.evidence: Assistant text in log: "**Classification: architectural**, and I want to flag why, since \"add a parameter\" sounds bounded."; file exists: docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-17-login-user-tracking-design.md (find docs -type f)

criteria.criterion: spec presented for review before implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "**Please review the spec and tell me if you want any changes before I write the implementation plan.**" and "No code gets written before that."; git status shows no source files modified (only untracked .gitignore)

criteria.criterion: did NOT classify as bounded / skip spec
criteria.evidence: Agent explicitly stated classification architectural and committed a spec file to disk; no in-chat-only bounded design occurred

criteria.criterion: did NOT classify as spike / probe plan
criteria.evidence: jq over assistant texts showed no spike classification; flow went classification→clarifying questions→spec doc→approval gate
